ops.title: Launcher.Paths is NOT dead — the validate clause is a fail-fast guard four consumers set and two pin in tests
ops.body:
Decision 2026-08-30: **do not delete `cc-interact daemon.Launcher.Paths`.** A plan step called it "written and validated but read nowhere since `classifyAbsence` went" and scheduled its removal plus two setter deletions in cc-present. The premise fails three ways; the lane stopped before editing and both worktrees were left clean.

**1 — Four repos set it, not one.** All four pin `cc-interact v0.32.1` at origin/main:

| repo | site |
|---|---|
| cc-present | `internal/app/app.go:84` |
| cc-orchestrate | `orchestrate/app.go:83` |
| cc-review | `internal/cli/deps.go:23` |
| cc-skills | `plugins/codex/consumer.go:63` (separate module `cc-skills/plugins/codex`) |

cc-review and cc-skills were not in the plan at all.

**2 — cc-present has ONE launcher assignment, not two.** The plan named "app.go:84 and :90". They are different fields on different structs:

    app.go:84  return ccd.Launcher{Daemon: spec, Paths: Paths(), RuntimeBuild: version.String()}, nil
    app.go:90  Paths: Paths(),        // inside cmd.Deps{...}, i.e. cc-interact/cmd/cmd.go:25 Deps.Paths

`Deps.Paths` is read in production at cc-interact `cmd/setupchannels.go:52,88,95`, `cmd/channel.go:72`, `cmd/watch.go:52,59`. Deleting line 90 would have broken cc-present's channel-setup marker and its SSE watch-cursor seeding.

**3 — The validate clause is deliberate, and two consumers pin it on purpose.** Inside cc-interact the only read is `daemon/launcher.go:178`, as the plan said. But:

    cc-review/internal/cli/root_test.go:23-27
      // Paths and RuntimeBuild are required by Launcher.validate but optional to
      // the compiler, so an omission surfaces only on the first daemon call.

    cc-present/internal/app/daemon_runtime_test.go:63-67
      // TestLauncherCarriesEveryRequiredField exercises ccd.Launcher.validate, which
      // demands Paths and RuntimeBuild beside the identity.

So the clause is fail-fast for a field the compiler cannot require, not vestige. "Delete the dead field" has no minimal form, because nothing in the current shape is dead.

**Options weighed and rejected:** a five-repo coordinated removal (largest blast radius, and it deletes a guard consumers deliberately assert — two of the four repos were mid-release at the time); a cc-interact-only removal (leaves four repos unrepinnable, since an unknown field in a composite literal is a hard compile error); a rescope to severing the launcher's `paths` dependency (a different change needing its own decision).

If someone later wants the launcher off the `paths` package, that is the real question — not this deletion.</body>
